title: santolina pallida
intro: Santolina pallida, commonly known as Grey Cotton Lavender or Silvery Wormwood, is a perennial shrubby plant within the Asteraceae family. It is prized for its silvery-gray foliage and small yellow flowers, which have been used in traditional herbal medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Santolina pallida include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
